Do not assume that the written instructions fully describe how the game behaves; treat your understanding of its mechanics as something you can test. Try promising variations of the available actions, observe the actual outcomes, and update your strategy from that evidence. Your reason remains private; actions/outcomes may become public as described. There is no post-game reflection.
